verdict.qualification: Conditional on all explicit domain/admission/closed-suffix conditions; this is not a generic noexcept claim for arbitrary GuiTypeCounterHost, Native exceptions or future providers. Group Native suffix remains separately recovered/reviewed by lineage worker.
verdict.ordinary_cpp_escape_after_successful_ele: Unreachable for exact supported closed Source suffix under stated conditions; no general noexcept, SEH/fault or future-provider claim.

proof.statement: The actual private adapter constructs CounterHost final with TypeIdCounterLifetime final; its counter override calls only that same nonvirtual get_006fac20. ParentInit is a reference-only direct lambda, not a user callback or std::function. LightTypeBootstrap construction/storage access are noexcept metadata operations.

Cold Element sets its private guard/name, runs actual root initialization, copies current root ID, obtains the actual counter, and increments/stores its own ID. Real C++ escapes from cold get allocation/manager/registration occur before this complete return. Partial guard, name, root, publication and counter state remain sticky.

After a genuine normally completed cold Element, the counter getter returned a valid actual owner; its published cell is nonnull. Serialized retained-domain lifetime forbids clearing/replacing/freeing it between that return and later role work.

The exact get_006fac20 nonnull arm is one current global load, null test and return of that first load. It does not enter SoundLifetimeAccess, manager getter/registration, allocator, lock, callback or destructor. The actual post-Element provider can therefore produce no ordinary C++ escape.

Actual Text suffix is only two plain parent-ID copies, that exact warm counter getter and uint32 postincrement/publication. Trivial local cleanup and enum returned assignment add no throw. Proposed recovered Group suffix must likewise remain two current parent loads/copies, same warm get, current +4 read, increment and ordered stores, then returned metadata.

Thus supported ordinary C++ failure after successful Element but before the owning Text/Group role becomes returned is unreachable. Between externally serialized entries, a completed Element implies a completed role; a role entered/threw without a completed role cannot be used as Element completion.

Base case is private loader-zero Element cells. Only cold Text or Group may first enter them. Cold cross-entry rejects the other role entered/threw before native effects, including reentry during cold manager/registration callbacks. Layer still requires completed Text. This preserves the induction for the hot Element guard arm.

A nonzero Element guard or nonnull counter alone never proves Element completion: cold getter failure can leave either sticky before Element finishes. Only returned role metadata plus the closed-domain proof admits reuse.

required_implementation_conditions: Bind counter_/root_/root_guard_ once, or check all three pointer identities. Text must not overwrite an already bound Group-first domain; no reading/copying type IDs or native guard to validate this metadata admission.

Keep the exact actual counter lifetime, publication cell and published object plus canonical root/guard alive without drain, reset, replacement or concurrent mutation through every role initialization and consumer/shared shutdown. Equal owner addresses alone do not authorize a retired/reused lifetime.
Preserve current Text completed-pool prerequisite. Group type initialization has no Text-completion or Group/Text payload-pool prerequisite and may be first; it creates no pool startup.

Own returned entry checks same domain and keeps its old prerequisites, then returns before any unrelated other-role failure veto. Own entered/failed state cannot replay. Cold Text rejects Group entered/threw; cold Group rejects Text entered/threw, all before native guard/name/counter effects.

Mark the target role entered/threw before the first native guard/name effect; set returned only after the last successful native ID publication. Preserve all partial guards/name/parent/counter/ID stores on throw, with no rollback, reset or retry.
Only Text/Group may first enter the private Element adapter; keep Layer completion and same-domain checks unchanged. Group-completed is not a substitute for completed Text at Layer admission.
Retain old Element/Text/Layer getter gates. Do not introduce a global interrupted-state veto that hides already completed role lineage; a new Group getter uses only completed Group state.

Extend native_operation_interrupted() with group_type_state_==State::threw, retaining all existing pool/type/Layer terms and no callbacks/native reads. This feeds game_hosts.cpp3122 and existing game_main startup catch retention boundaries.

Do not add any fallible validation, allocation, provider/callback, logging, lock acquisition, registration, generic host substitution or other ordinary C++ escape after Element return and before role returned metadata.

Existing predicate would be false and game_hosts startup catch could rethrow through the sticky VFS/counter/root graph instead of its established _Exit retention boundary.
